## Original answer (verbatim)

Stack heaviest and flattest at the bottom, and don't try to stack the eggs on each other at all — that's the piece that makes this hard.

Structure, bottom to top:

Laptop (closed) on the table. It's the widest, flattest, heaviest item, so it makes the best foundation.
Book flat on top of the laptop. Another wide, flat platform, and it keeps the center of mass low.
Wine bottle standing upright in the center of the book. Its base is narrow-ish but flat, and the heavy glass bottom keeps it steady on a level surface.
Nine eggs lying on their sides on the book, arranged in a ring around the bottle's base. Nestled against the bottle and each other, they can't roll far in any direction.
Nail lying flat on the book (or dropped into the bottle if it's empty, if you want it truly out of the way).

Why this works: every item rests on a broad, flat surface, the center of mass stays close to the table, and nothing tall or round is asked to support anything else. The eggs are the only things that can't be stacked reliably, so they go last and low, on their sides, braced by the bottle.

What not to do: don't stand the eggs on end, don't put anything on top of the bottle, and don't try an egg pyramid — without a carton, eggs won't hold that shape.

## Transcription into a chain (not a played route)

1. 💻 (root) — The laptop, closed, is the widest, flattest, heaviest object.
2. 📖 (root) — The book is a rigid flat rectangle.
3. 🍷 (root) — The bottle is tall with a flat, heavy base.
4. 🥚 (root) — Eggs roll on a flat surface and cannot be stacked without a carton.
5. 📌 (root) — The nail is a thin spike with no stable rest of its own.
6. ❓ (← 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) — Asked: arrange these five so the whole resists toppling, using nothing else.
7. 🏔️ (← 1, 2) — Heaviest and flattest go lowest: laptop on the table, book on the laptop — a broad, low foundation.
8. ⚓ (← 7) — Everything rests on a broad flat surface, so the centre of mass stays near the table.
9. 🧍 (← 3, 7) — The bottle stands upright in the centre of the book on its own flat base.
10. 📐 (← 4, 9) — Eggs lie on their sides in a ring around the bottle's base, braced by the bottle and each other, so none can roll far.
11. 🚫 (← 4) — Nothing is placed on the bottle; eggs are never stood on end or pyramided.
12. 🪨 (← 5, 3) — (latent in the prose) The nail could be dropped into the bottle, where it sinks and is out of the way.
13. 🫙 (← 12) — (not recognised in the prose) That removes the one object with no stable rest from the problem — a second principle, containment, left as an aside.
14. 👀 (← 8, 10, 11) — Self-check: every object rests on something broad and low; the eggs, the only unstackable item, are braced rather than stacked.
15. 🏁 (← 8, 10) — Conclusion: a low, broad stack with the eggs ringed and braced.

LANDMARKS:
- Heaviest and flattest objects form a broad low base (laptop, then book).
- The bottle stands on its own flat base; nothing is placed on it.
- The eggs are laid on their sides in a ring, braced by the bottle, rather than stacked.
- (latent) The nail can be dropped into the bottle, which contains it.

ANSWER: Laptop flat on the table, book flat on it, bottle upright in the centre, eggs on their sides in a ring around the bottle, nail flat on the book or inside the bottle.
